review.assessment: This change replaces a hard-coded check for DONE and FAILED statuses with `st.is_terminal()`, ensuring that self-cancelled jobs stop their time accrual at `ended_at` instead of continuously running against the current clock. It directly addresses the SLA report inflation for cancelled jobs by aligning `finished_at()` with the lifecycle specification cited in the code comment. The acceptance suite passes cleanly, validating the fix without regressions.
